news_summary: Business leaders in New Hampshire are warning that the Trump administration's immigration policies risk turning away foreign workers the state cannot replace, as employers face shortages in factories, hospitals and technology firms.
payoff: Employers say immigration has to be part of the solution to ensure the state has the talent and workforce to compete.
